payload.title: Step 2: unified_sme.py simulated SME (label, rule, reason, leak guards, cache, fake)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Step 2: `unified_sme.py`, the simulated SME.

## Scope

- Prompt holding the full policy F; one call per item, independent of the classifier's verdict; batched labeling.
- Output: label, rule ID, one-sentence reason (<= 25 words, about the review, not reciting policy wording), optional verbatim quote FROM THE REVIEW, or UNEXPLAINABLE/ambiguous.
- Leak guards: reuse `unified_labeler.validate_explanation`; reject any 8-gram overlap with F; keep `MAX_RULE_REPEATS`.
- sqlite cache shared by all arms; text-free logs.
- Per-arm feedback built from the cached record ("should be X because ..." when wrong; "correct: ..." when right).
- Fake SME for specs. Model: gpt-6-sol if available (verify), else gpt-6-luna (noted); analyst stays gpt-6-luna. Agreement-check hook (second pass/model on 100 items).

## Definition of done

Specs beside the module pass offline (validators, leak guard, cache, fake); `make test` green; existing replays byte-identical.

## Caps

$0 (offline).
